```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://127.0.0.1/nonexistent.dtd">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY % intEnt "<!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>">
  %intEnt;
]>
<root xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <item>External subset and entity declarations</item>
  <xi:include href="nonexistent.xml" parse="xml">
    <xi:fallback>
      <item>Fallback content triggered</item>
    </xi:fallback>
  </xi:include>
</root>
```

  </child>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (#PCDATA|child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Entity replacement text">
  <!ENTITY recursive "&base; &base; &base; &base; &base;">
]>
<root>
  <child>&recursive;</child>
  CDATA section test: <![CDATA[ <tag> & unparsed text inside cdata section ]]>
</root>
```

  <!ELEMENT catalog (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author, price)>
  <!ATTLIST book id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
]>
<catalog>
  <book id="b101">
    <title>XML Validation Guide</title>
    <author>Jane Doe</author>
    <price currency="USD">29.99</price>
  </book>
</catalog>
